knock_knee_correction_short_des: Special workouts designed by professional physical therapists, aiming at fixing knock knees and correcting your gait.
knock_knees_des_2:
Tight hip adductors, weak gluteals, and flat feet can cause knock knees. It puts a lot of pressure on the knees and can cause severe pain and walking problems. 

To correct it, you need to strengthen the muscles that pull your knees back into place and stretch the muscles that pull them in. Designed by professional physical therapists, this training plan helps to stretch and release your adductors, strengthen your glutes and correct your gait.

Obesity can also cause knock knees. We recommend that you use this program with our slim leg training if necessary.
bow_legs_correction_short_des: Special workouts designed by professional physical therapists, aiming at fixing bow legs and correcting your gait.
bow_legs_des_2:
Bowlegs are largely caused by tight external rotators, weak hip adductors and poor gait. To fix bow legs, you need to strengthen the muscles that pull your knees back into place and stretch the muscles that pull them out. 

This training plan was designed by professional physical therapists and helps strengthen hip adductors, stretch and loosen up external rotators and correct your gait.
